import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    g = p[0] + p[1]*eps**p[2] + p[3]*np.log(eps)
    h = 1 + p[4]*T + p[5]*T**2 + p[6]*T*eps
    return g*h + p[7]*eps*T**2 + p[8]*T**2*eps**2 + p[9]
